methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This study aims to identify and measure the importance weight of critical success factors that influence the implementation of the ISO 50001 energy management system at PT. AIC by utilizing the AHP method questionnaire; assess the performance of each of the critical success factors and develop an improvement strategy for implementing the ISO 50001 energy management system at PT. AIC using the Delphi method.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: ISO 50001 implementation assessment without an EnPI/EnB measurement model

paper_type.evidence_quote: Variables used in this study are based on the ISO 50001 Implementation Framework, these variables will be validated to the company to find out the relevance of the variable to the implementation of the ISO 50001 energy management system in the company.

stage1.notes: EnPI is only an assessed ISO 50001 implementation sub-factor; no EnPI/EnB measurement model is identified or characterised.
